system_prompt: You are a careful engineer. Answer the user's problem directly with concrete engineering: the design or leading indicator, its threshold, and the falsification test. Respect every stated constraint verbatim. English only. Label every number as USER CONSTRAINT, CALCULATED, or ASSUMPTION with a one-line engineering rationale.
a1_answer:
DESIGN/INDICATOR: Dead-end main flushing program with hydraulic modeling-based frequency
THRESHOLD: Flushing frequency determined by model to maintain chlorine residual >1.0 mg/L at all dead-end termini during maximum summer demand (25°C)
CALCULATED: Model predicts chlorine decay rate in each dead-end and calculates required flushing frequency to maintain residual above 1.0 mg/L at the farthest customer
ASSUMPTION: Existing distribution system hydraulic model accurately represents actual flow patterns and dead-end conditions

FALSIFICATION TEST: Install continuous chlorine and nitrite monitors at the farthest customer of three representative dead-end mains. Implement the calculated flushing program. Monitor for 90 days during summer maximum demand conditions. If any monitor detects chlorine residual <1.0 mg/L OR nitrite >0.5 mg/L (regulatory limit), the flushing program fails to mitigate the problem.
